items.t: Fuel pump can fail and cut drive power (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Genesis dealer
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Turbo oil feed pipe can leak and cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Genesis dealer
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: ABS module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Genesis dealer
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Starter solenoid can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Genesis dealer
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Trunk can't be opened from the inside (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Genesis dealer
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Fuel pump nozzle blockage can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Genesis dealer
items.note: Free at a dealer under the recall.

items.t: Loss of power from a worn high-pressure fuel pump
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump and update engine software
items.note: Ask a dealer about bulletin 25-FL-002G first; it may be covered. RepairPal's G70 fuel pump estimates run about $1,080-$1,390.

items.t: Hard, jerky downshifts when slowing down
items.job: Transmission adaptive reset and software update; shift solenoids if needed
items.note: A reset is cheap. Owners report solenoid jobs around $1,500 and full transmission replacement near $9,000-$10,000 out of warranty.

items.t: Transmission slipping or gear ratio fault
items.job: Diagnose transmission; replace solenoid/valve body or transmission
items.note: Range runs from a solenoid repair to a complete transmission. Check powertrain warranty coverage first.

items.t: Steering wheel shake or pulsing pedal when braking
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Resurfacing the rotors costs less if they are thick enough.

items.t: Engine won't restart after auto stop-start
items.job: Apply stop-start bulletin repair and test starter circuit

items.t: Connected Services app errors or dropouts
items.job: Infotainment software update or system reset

items.t: Radio app crashes or false 'Uneven Road Ahead' warning

items.job: Inspect headlight seals and vents; replace headlight assembly if needed
items.note: LED headlight assemblies are expensive; check warranty first.

items.t: Soft brake pedal from air in the brake unit
items.job: Bleed brakes and hydraulic control unit with scan tool

items.t: Check engine light for fuel rail pressure sensor
items.job: Engine computer update; replace fuel pressure sensor if needed
items.note: RepairPal puts G70 fuel pressure sensor replacement around $180-$310.

items.t: Rear lamp trim pieces coming loose
items.note: Usually covered under warranty on newer cars.

items.job: Replace rear corner radar units and calibrate
items.note: Usually covered under warranty on a 2025.

items.t: Sunroof creaks or rattles over bumps
